comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: This can be created during Thanksgiving festival from the traveler in boston right next to the carriage. Requires natal indigo,eagle wings, and leather cord if i recall correctly. Base is 20 atk 10 def +1 plunder and +1 assault. I was able to create a gs of 35 atk 12 def. Anyone able to create higher? Like 40 atk? If so i would like to try and make more!

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body: 100 dura, 20att 10def, +1 plunder +1 assault. Produced from a r10 sewing recipe at one of the four NPCs present during the Great Thanksgiving festival (this one being produced at Boston near the carriage). Materials Required: 20x Natal Indigo, 30x Leather Cord, 20x Eagle's Wings.

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
I made 391 of those *cough* with refined Sewing R20 and all 4 oxford skills.

219 where a great success, with attack from 21 to 38.

On average the great success ones had 27.7 attack

How many high attack (30+) ones?
38: 4 times, 1.0%
37: 3 times, 0.8%
36: 2 times, 0.5%
35: 3 times, 0.8%
34: 9 times, 2.3%
33: 15 times, 3.8%
32: 5 times, 1.3%
31: 15 times, 3.8%
30: 15 times, 3.8%

Did not took notes about the def, the highest def of those i kept is 17, in theory 19 should be max. But def is roled seperatly from att, got high (38) att ones with somewhat high (17) def and with low (11) def.
